name: dot-engine
title: Dot engine
description: Shared canvas and SVG rendering utilities for dot animations.
usage: Building a dot story: `DotStory` with a grid, a resting picture and a lazy `load` that returns a player from `createBeatStoryPlayer` (beats) or `createDotStoryPlayer` (any frame function). Also `DotWindow` and `DotRule` around live content, and `PauseWhenOffscreen` inside animated SVGs.
avoid: Hex colors in a story (use brand tokens through canvasColor)
Stories that keep playing off screen or with reduced motion
notes:
`DotStory` plays only while on screen and the tab is visible, loads its player the first time it scrolls into view, and
shows the resting picture instead of playing under reduced motion (followed live). Canvas code reads colors from brand
tokens: the dots take the frame's text color (`text-brand` by default), and `canvasColor(canvas, "var(--ds-color-...)")`
resolves any other token. A theme switch (a class or `data-theme` change on `<html>` that re-points those tokens) reloads
the story so it repaints in the new colors.

reference.source: src/components/sections/shared/dot-story.tsx and its dot-* modules (the same as src/components/dashboard-ui/dots/dot-*), src/components/sections/shared/pause-when-offscreen.tsx; src/components/sections/products/story-caption.ts
reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
